body: CODEC API CHECKPOINT (implementing): one public HsmmResultCodec with encode/toJson and contextual decode/decodeJson(recall, view); no context-free Decoder[HsmmResult]. HsmmCodecError keeps JSON/codec failures distinct from the original typed AlignError. Wire DTOs remain private[codec]; sparse maps are arrays of explicit records sorted by unit/state/ref so composite keys never become stringly JSON and duplicate entries are rejected before toMap. Materialization order: rows/matrix smart constructors; member/reduction/cost records only through AlignWire; HsmmResult.validated(candidateAnchors, Some(echo)); mandatory AlignWire.matched(viewFingerprint, recallChecksum). Top-level schemaVersion is required. This adds no dependency or module and preserves the contextual proof boundary; flag objections while I implement in the reserved isolated worktree.
